title: Illumina DNA Prep Part 5: Clean Up Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Magnetic module is engaged for 5 minutes
Samples are air dryed for 5 minutes
Magnetic module is engaged for 2 minutes

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (initial)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add IPB to columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 15 µL of IPB to columns 7‑12 on the magnetic module, mixing the IPB tubes every other aspiration using a bead‑mixing cycle (aspirate from bottom, dispense 3 mm higher, aspirate at that height, dispense to bottom) and repeat this cycle 10 times total.

steps.title: Transfer and mix supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 125 µL of supernatant from columns 1‑6 (left side) to columns 7‑12 (right side) on the magnetic module and mix 10 times at a volume of 120 µL.

steps.title: Re‑engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the resulting supernatant from columns 7‑12.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the beads in columns 7‑12 twice with 100 µL of 80 % ethanol, discarding the supernatant after each wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL 80 % ethanol, mix briefly, then remove supernatant.
Repeat the addition, mix, and removal a second time.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Use a 20 µL pipette to ensure complete removal of any remaining ethanol after the second wash.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add RSB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 32 µL of RSB to columns 7‑12 on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module (final)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer final supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL of the resulting supernatant from the magnetic module to the final 96‑well plate located in slot 2.
